product_name: Motorola G06 Power (Pantone Laurel Oak, 4GB RAM, 64GB Storage) | 6.88" 120Hz Display | 50MP Camera | Helio G81 Ultra Processor | 7000mAh Battery | Android 15
description: ☆【RAM, ROM And Expandable】: Equipped with 4GB RAM and 64GB internal storage for everyday apps, photos, videos, and essential files. The smartphone also supports expandable storage via a dedicated microSDXC card slot for added convenience. ☆【Display】: Features a large 6.88" HD+ IPS LCD display with 120Hz refresh rate for smooth scrolling and comfortable viewing. The 720 x 1640 resolution and Corning Gorilla Glass 3 protection add to its everyday usability. ☆【Camera】: Capture clear photos with the 50MP rear camera with PDAF, while the 8MP front camera is suitable for selfies and video calls. Both front and rear cameras support 1080p video recording. ☆【Processor】: Powered by the MediaTek Helio G81 Ultra octa-core processor and paired with Android 15, delivering reliable performance for daily tasks such as browsing, streaming, social media, and multitasking. ☆【Battery】: Comes with a massive 7000mAh battery designed for long-lasting daily use, helping you stay powered for longer. It also supports 18W wired charging for added convenience
